I avoid products tested on animals.

### assistant
 I can understand why you avoid products tested on animals. Animal testing can cause unnecessary harm and suffering to animals, and there are many alternative testing methods available that are more humane and ethical. By avoiding products tested on animals, you are taking a stand against animal cruelty and supporting companies that prioritize ethical treatment of animals.

If you need help finding products that are not tested on animals, there are several resources available to you. Many companies now label their products as "cruelty-free" or "not tested on animals," so look for these labels when shopping. You can also check out websites like Leaping Bunny, PETA, or Cruelty Free Kitty, which provide lists of companies that do not test on animals.

Additionally, you can support legislation that bans animal testing. In the United States, for example, the Humane Cosmetics Act aims to prohibit animal testing for cosmetics. By advocating for laws that protect animals, you can help create a more ethical and humane world.

Overall, avoiding products tested on animals is a compassionate and responsible choice. Thank you for taking a stand against animal cruelty and promoting ethical treatment of animals
